title: [오븐없이!] 화덕에 구운 것 같은 감자치즈빵! (후라이팬으로 맛있는 빵 만들기, Potato Cheese Bread)

segments.description: Close-up shot of a knife slicing into a warm, golden-brown potato cheese bread on parchment paper, revealing a gooey, stretchy cheese filling to entice the viewer.
Medium close-up of the freshly sliced potato cheese bread being pulled apart, showing rich melted mozzarella and inviting the audience to enjoy the snack with honey.
Medium shot of bread flour, milk, melted butter, and salt being added into a glass mixing bowl to establish the recipe's ingredients.
Medium close-up of dough being kneaded by hand and then wrapped in cling film to rest in the refrigerator, demonstrating the dough preparation step.
Medium shot of a boiled potato being mashed in a wooden bowl and mixed with mayonnaise to prepare the savory potato filling.
Medium shot of the rested dough being rolled out flat with a wooden rolling pin on a wooden surface to form the bread base.
Medium close-up of mozzarella cheese and mashed potato filling being layered onto the flattened dough before securely pinching the edges closed.
Medium shot of the stuffed dough bundle being gently rolled out into a smooth, flat circular shape using a rolling pin.
Medium shot of butter being brushed evenly across the surface of a heated frying pan under low flame to prepare for cooking.
Medium shot of the bread cooking in the frying pan, getting brushed with melted butter and flipped until both sides turn golden-brown.
Close-up shot of the finished potato cheese bread being sliced, pulled apart, and dipped into honey to highlight the delicious final result.
